name: CLAMEUR
positioning: French private-rental rent observatory built from signed leases collected at source, with a mapping application for members and free published trends.
description: CLAMEUR is an association that produces an observatory of rents in the French private rental sector. It collects signed leases through partnerships with professional unions, federations, networks and managers rather than from advertisements, and states it holds more than a million references per year. Free national, regional, departmental and metropolitan trend pages publish rents excluding charges and their four-year evolution by property type. Members and contributors additionally get a web application with mapped navigation, indicators, charts, an advanced geolocated search and access to the underlying lease references down to municipality and IRIS zone level. Bespoke studies can be commissioned.
real_estate_use: Rent evidence in France is scarce outside the regulated observatories, and portal asking prices are not the same thing as signed rents. CLAMEUR is the counter-evidence: it is built from executed leases handed over by managers, so a letting agent pricing a lot, a landlord arguing an indexation, or an investor testing a yield assumption can cite an actual market rent for the commune rather than an advertised one. The granularity down to IRIS zone is what makes it usable in cities where two neighbourhoods a kilometre apart do not rent alike. Local authorities and rent-control policy work use it for the same reason — it is one of the few sources covering medium-sized towns and rural areas.
features: Rent observatory built from signed leases collected through professional partners
Free national, regional, departmental and metropolitan trend pages with four-year evolution
Member web application with mapped navigation and charted indicators
Granularity down to municipality and IRIS zone
Advanced geolocated search over lease references

use_cases.job: Price a rental lot against signed rents in the same commune rather than against portal asking prices
Test a rental yield assumption on a medium-sized town that commercial datasets barely cover
